requirements: R1: Replace the built-in static arrays of dummy data with the backend's actual API response for the search endpoint.
R2: Implement data view states for empty, loading, error, and present, ensuring that when the backend returns zero rows or is stopped, the page displays no domain records.

slices.title: Replace hardcoded records with backend response and states
slices.jtbd: When implementing the search data binding for this epic, I want to use the actual server response and handle its states, so that the page asserts only true claims about the database.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend is stopped or returns zero rows,
When the user performs a search,
Then the page must display no domain records and a true empty state.
Given the backend returns an error or is loading,
When the user performs a search,
Then the page must display the corresponding error or loading state without showing hardcoded data.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of hardcoded false documents shown from 12 to 0.
